rationale: A fair value gap is the footprint of one-sided urgency, so when the aggressive order flow also leads the same way, the first return into the gap meets waiting interest on that side. Losing side: Traders who fade the move and sell into the gap while buyers still lead the flow (the mirror for short).

filter.plain: only when net buying volume of the last 5 minutes points the trade's way (long needs buyers ahead, short sellers) and its share of volume is at least its 20-day median for that window

notes: fvg: three bars of the session leave a fair value gap (bar 3's low above bar 1's high = an up gap, the mirror = a down gap) at least min_gap x ATR high -> an entry WITH the gap: touch = a limit at its near edge, mid = a limit at its middle, go = a market order at once; the newest gap replaces an older gap's resting entry
